title: Appointment Booking Policy
content: Appointments are confirmed after slot validation. Online bookings prevent double-booking and preserve the selected schedule.

title: Reschedule Policy
content: Patients may reschedule subject to doctor availability. Conflicting slots are blocked automatically.

title: Feedback Policy
content: Feedback can be submitted only after the doctor marks the appointment as completed.

title: Reminder Policy
content: Reminder emails are sent approximately 24 hours and 1 hour before confirmed appointments.
